What It’s Like To Live In West Lake Hills

If you picture quiet, tree‑lined streets with sweeping Hill Country views just minutes from Austin’s core, West Lake Hills likely tops your list. You get space, privacy, and a small‑city feel without giving up access to big‑city amenities. In this guide, you’ll learn what daily life looks like, how the housing market behaves, and the key checks to make before you buy. Let’s dive in.

West Lake Hills at a glance

West Lake Hills is a small, incorporated city in Travis County with about 3.6 square miles and a 2020 Census population of 3,444. You’ll find large lots, mature trees, and scenic ridgelines in a close‑in Hill Country setting. For a quick city snapshot, see the city’s Wikipedia overview.

Because West Lake Hills is its own municipality, it operates city services and maintains city‑specific rules and resources. Start with the City of West Lake Hills site if you need contacts, permits, or boundary details.

Hill Country lifestyle and outdoors

Life here leans outdoors. You can catch sunrise or sunset from a ridge, then take a short drive to trailheads. The Wild Basin Wilderness Preserve offers about 227 acres of trails and overlooks that feel like a nature getaway inside the city’s orbit. Plan your visit using the Wild Basin visitor page.

On weekends, many residents enjoy quick scenic drives along Loop 360 and photo‑worthy stops at popular overlooks. Lake Austin access points and the Barton Creek Greenbelt are nearby for hiking, swimming holes, and rock scrambling when conditions allow.

Homes, lots, and privacy

Housing in West Lake Hills is dominated by single‑family homes, often custom builds or high‑end rebuilds. Expect an architectural mix: mid‑century ranches, Mediterranean and Mission inspirations, and sleek contemporary hilltop estates. Many properties sit on larger lots than you’ll find in central Austin, including half‑acre to acre sites in sought‑after pockets. Waterfront and gated enclaves along Lake Austin can command premium pricing.

Commercial areas inside city limits are limited. That tradeoff is part of the appeal: quiet residential streets, dark skies, and natural scenery, with shopping and services a short drive away.

Schools and zoning essentials

Every address in West Lake Hills lies within Eanes Independent School District, which is widely recognized for strong academics and programs. Review campuses and attendance details on the Eanes ISD schools page, and confirm a specific address with the district before you buy. Third‑party rankings often place Eanes among the top districts in Texas; see current snapshots on Niche’s Eanes ISD profile.

Two practical tips if schools are a priority:

  • Check the exact attendance zone for the property. Boundaries can shift over time.
  • Understand how zoning interacts with nearby micro‑neighborhoods within 78746, since pricing often reflects school access.

Getting around and daily errands

West Lake Hills sits immediately west of central Austin, which keeps many commutes manageable outside peak traffic. Rush hours vary by route and time, so test your door‑to‑desk timing on the schedules that matter to you.

With low commercial density inside city limits, daily errands typically mean short drives to neighborhood centers on Bee Cave Road or Westlake Drive, larger clusters in Bee Cave and the Hill Country Galleria area, or into central Austin for expanded dining and entertainment.

Market snapshot and costs

West Lake Hills is an affluent, low‑inventory market with a wide range of price points at the top end. For context, Zillow’s neighborhood index shows a typical home value around $1.98 million as of February 28, 2026. See the latest on the Zillow ZHVI page.

Recent public snapshots also report multi‑million‑dollar medians, with month‑to‑month changes that reflect small sample sizes. Redfin, for example, showed a median sale price around $2.6 million in February 2026, with notable variability. You can review current figures on Redfin’s West Lake Hills market page.

A few takeaways for planning:

  • Use a current, date‑stamped source when quoting medians.
  • Expect a broad spread in price per square foot due to lot size, views, and custom finishes.
  • Very high‑end properties can have longer marketing windows than mid‑range listings.

Property taxes and city services

  • City tax rate: West Lake Hills adopted a FY2025–26 city rate of 0.176783. This is the city’s portion only; your total bill also includes Eanes ISD, Travis County, and other entities. See the rate reference in Community Impact’s local reporting: city tax rate overview.
  • Wastewater: Some properties connect to city wastewater, while others use on‑site septic systems or grinder pumps. Review the city’s wastewater and OSSF guidance before making an offer.

Buyer checklist for West Lake Hills

Before you write an offer, work through these items to avoid surprises:

  1. Confirm the municipality
  • Some 78746 addresses fall inside Austin or unincorporated Travis County. Jurisdiction affects taxes, utilities, and codes. Consult the City of West Lake Hills site for boundary context and resources.
  1. Verify wastewater service
  • Ask whether the property connects to city wastewater or uses an on‑site septic/OSSF or grinder pump. Maintenance, permitting, and future remodel plans can differ. Start with the city’s wastewater page.
  1. Evaluate topography and site work
  • Steep slopes, rock outcrops, and long driveways can increase construction costs. Review local standards for slope and driveway rules in the city code, and consider a geotechnical evaluation for major additions or new construction.
  1. Plan for wildfire risk and vegetation management
  • Brush and summer heat make defensible‑space practices relevant. The city publishes Firewise and preparedness information; review guidance and ask sellers about recent mitigation work.
  1. Understand HOAs and deed restrictions
  • There is no city‑wide HOA, but some gated communities and subdivisions have associations. Title work and seller disclosures should outline any deed restrictions.
  1. Think about resale and liquidity
  • The area sees fewer transactions and wide price bands. Expect variability in comps and marketing times at the highest price points.

Is West Lake Hills right for you?

You will likely enjoy living in West Lake Hills if you:

  • Prioritize privacy, large lots, and Hill Country views.
  • Want access to Eanes ISD and plan to verify the exact attendance zone.
  • Prefer a quiet residential setting and do not need walkable retail at your doorstep.
  • Have a budget for a luxury‑leaning market, along with ongoing maintenance for larger lots and hillside sites.

If you want an ultra‑walkable, restaurant‑dense neighborhood, you may prefer areas inside central Austin. If you want more space, views, and schools in a close‑in setting, West Lake Hills delivers.

Plan a weekend preview

  • Morning: Hike the Wild Basin Wilderness Preserve for a feel of the terrain and tree canopy.
  • Midday: Drive Loop 360 and stop at a ridge overlook to understand sightlines and road access patterns.
  • Afternoon: Tour a few micro‑neighborhoods to compare lot sizes, topography, and proximity to Bee Cave Road.
  • Evening: Sample dining in nearby Bee Cave or central Austin, then return to appreciate the night sky and quiet streets.

FAQs

How close is West Lake Hills to downtown Austin?

  • It is a close‑in Hill Country city immediately west of central Austin. Commute times vary widely by route and time of day, so test your specific drive during peak and off‑peak hours.

Are West Lake Hills public schools part of Eanes ISD?

  • Yes. Every address in the city falls within Eanes ISD. Verify a property’s current campus assignments on the district’s schools page.

How expensive are homes in West Lake Hills?

  • It is a luxury market. Zillow’s index showed a typical value near $1.98M as of February 28, 2026, and Redfin has reported multi‑million‑dollar medians with month‑to‑month swings. Check the latest figures on Zillow and Redfin.

What should I know about utilities and wastewater?

  • Some homes connect to city wastewater, while others use septic or grinder pumps. Review the city’s wastewater guidance and confirm the setup before you buy.

What is the city property tax rate in West Lake Hills?

  • The city adopted a FY2025–26 rate of 0.176783 for its portion of the bill. Total taxes also include Eanes ISD, Travis County, and other entities. See Community Impact’s rate overview.
